guide.title: How to Order Your SCAPE
guide.subtitle: 4 simple steps from coordinates to checkout

step1.title: Select Coordinates & Area
step1.desc1: Find any location in Norway and click to center the map, or drag the box. Use <bold>Capture Size</bold> to adjust coverage and <bold>Terrain Height</bold> for elevation exaggeration. The defalt 2.0x is 1:1 scale.
step1.desc2: <bold>Generate Scape</bold> to preview the model or to continue.

step2.title: Choose Frame
step2.desc: Select a frame to your liking. Real-time stock availability is verified automatically.

step3.title: Add Passe-Partout
step3.desc: Choose an archival bevel-cut matboard to give your 3D model enhanced architectural depth.

step4.title: Review & Vipps Checkout
step4.desc: Finalize in seconds with Vipps. Each piece is 3D printed in Bergen and delivered nationwide via Posten with tracking.

guide.tip: Tip: Remember to preview the model in step 1.
